issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: brick_stairs, red_tulip.

notes.detail: Shutters on every ground-floor window, trapdoor planters with poppy and tulip by the door, hanging lanterns under the jetty, log pile with barrel, bench, carpets, wall shelves and an upstairs lantern.
notes.depth: Shutters add depth to the ground floor, but the upper storey long sides are still a flat plaster band with no window.
notes.roof: Unchanged from L1: steep, overhang, finished ridge and gable trim.
notes.life: Two planters and lanterns; no path or fence yet.

visual.summary: L1 plus the dressing: shutters, flower planters by the doorstep, lanterns under the jetty, a log pile and bench on the east side, chimney base stairs and more furniture inside.
problems: The hanging lanterns at (3,3,1) and (5,3,1) hang right in front of the ground-floor windows at (3,2,2) and (5,2,2); consider moving them over the door or onto the brackets beside the windows.
Upper storey long sides (x2 and x6, y5) are still windowless plaster (carried over from L1).
Reachability: same as L1, 93 of 131 reached; only roof slopes, chimney top and a barrel top are unreached. Fine.
